c74object.name: lp.zippie
c74object.description: lp.zippie generates random integers from 1 upwards with a Zipf distribution; the exponent controls how steeply the probabilities fall.

objarg.name: seed
objarg.digest: Seed for the random number generator (0, the default, seeds automatically)

method.name: seed
method.digest: Reseed the random number generator (0 seeds automatically)
method.description: Reseed the random number generator (0 seeds automatically).
